title: New World Spotlight layouts, Space face and eleven email types

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail:
Six Spotlight layouts and doors from each kit's tools, the Space page following register, accent and type voice while synced, eleven email templates.

2026-11-03: the six Spotlight layouts and kit doors are ported from the stale Services-token draft #4505 (head 8bb2841) to --nw-* and New World: components/spotlight/new-world-kit-layouts.tsx, new-world-kit-layouts-css.ts, lib/spotlight/new-world-kit-content.ts and a test. Standalone: layouts.ts, theme.ts and the Spotlight shell are not wired yet (those pinned tests need Daniel's phrases). Only the Tide accent exists, so every kit hue wears Tide. Still open: wiring, the Space face following register/accent/voice, and the eleven email types (lib/theme/new-world-kit-email.ts). 2026-11-03: the layouts, kit content and the eleven email templates are built (lib/theme/new-world-kit-email.ts, catalog ids new-world-<type>); #4522's squash dropped the Spotlight files, restored here. Still open: registering the layouts in lib/spotlight/layouts.ts and the shell (pinned tests need owner phrases) and the Space face.

2026-11-03: closed by LIVE-2068 (#4543), which registered and drew the layouts in the live Spotlight.
